title: Common definitions
description: Shared patterns for contract v1. SoT §43 (all objects carry schema_version, tenant_id, correlation_id), PERD §32.3 (IDs are <prefix>_<ULID>).

SchemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the contract, major.minor.

Hash.description: sha256: followed by 64 lower-case hex characters (PERD §21.3 step 2).

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with a Z suffix.

Id.description: <prefix>_<body>. PERD §32.3 makes the body a ULID. The SoT examples (int_01J9X3, dec_7Q2) are illustrative and shorter, so the wire contract accepts 3 to 32 alphanumerics; ULID generation is the ID generator's job.

Sig.description: Key ID plus signature (SoT §43). HMAC-SHA-256 in the POC.

PackId.description: Namespaced ID in a pack: <vertical>.<segment>(.<segment>)*, all lower-case.

Vertical.description: The short namespace prefix of a pack, for example fin.

Predicate.description: An expression in the SoT §43.7 predicate language. Parsing and type-checking happen at pack load (packcheck), not here.
